UI Layout & 3-Step Workflow
Mode tabs, dual slots, list rows & Sanctum console
Five clear zones let you enchant, transmute, or cleanse in 3 steps:

Hover cost icons to compare options; Shift-click Blank Overwrite for stacks.

Three-Track Bookshelf System
7x5x7 obstruction-free scan, Wooden curve & Master Tomes
Scans +/-%s horizontal & +/-%s vertical blocks (7x5x7); blocks never obstruct it.
Blank Gear (Wooden): unlocks unenchanted gear up to ceil(MAX/2).
Upgrade Track (0–38 Wooden): unlocks existing traits up to MAX.
Master Tomes (Chiseled): stored books unlock 1..k on blank gear & Treasures!
Live Sync
Shelf and book changes update open menus live within 1 second.

Green Vanilla tiers, Purple Full XP & -40% discount cap

Purple -XL (Full): unstored enchants, Upgrades, Epiphanies & Curse Purge.

gui.chiseled_enchanting_table.grimoire.c: Book Loop
Book Upgrades & Delta Credit
0-material Combine, single-book Research & step credit
Two routes raise Master Tomes, and upgrades deduct prior costs.
Combine (0 Items): matching book in bag, 0.6x XP, yields 1 Depleted Tome.
Research (1 Book): 1 book + reagent (or Crystal) at 1.4x XP.
Delta Discount: L_cur -> L_new deducts paid items & costs 1–2L w/ Tome.
One Tome, Infinite Gear
Store one MAX Tome in a Chiseled Shelf to craft gear forever at 1–3L!

Treasure Epiphanies & Stasis
Mending, Swift Sneak, Stasis Freeze & instant Reroll
Treasure enchants (Mending, Silk Touch, etc.) unlock via two paths:
Path 1 [Master Tome]: store a Treasure book for 1-currency 1–3L crafts.
Path 2 [Grand Library]: %s+ Wooden Shelves roll Epiphanies every 10 min.
Unowned Epiphanies use 2 thematic items, or 1x Arcane Crystal alone.
Persistent Stasis
Freeze locks active Epiphanies — stasis timer survives mining the table!

1–3L vanilla rituals & 4-gate free Tome restoration
Base items in the top slot unlock golden 1–3L Vanilla Transmutations!
Craft XP Bottles, Echo Shards, Totems, Tridents & Enchanted Apples.
Consumes 1 item per click; Shift-click Blank Overwrite restores full stacks.
At %s+ Shelves & %s+ high Tomes, restoring Depleted Tomes is 100%% FREE!
Anti-Exploit Floor
XP Bottles require Lv.3+ and >= 11 XP points, preventing XP loops.
Cleanse
Cleanse, Step-Down & Curse Purge
Free wipe, 1-tier step-down, targeted strip & vanilla curse purge
Open the teal Cleanse tab to modify enchanted gear or books cleanly:
Disenchant All (Free): wipes non-curses, refunds XP & yields Cleansing Grit.
Step-Down (-1 Tier): lowers 1 level + XP refund; 1->0 book gives Depleted Tome.
Targeted Strip: removes 1 chosen trait while keeping all other traits intact.
Curse Purge: Golden Apple + Lapis, Echo Shard + Lapis, or 1x Arcane Crystal.
